_help: Your terminals in your colours. Aether rewrites them whenever your colours (wallpaper) or this file change. A colour: "" = from your scheme, "#ff88cc" = that colour, or a scheme colour name: primary, secondary, tertiary, onSurface, surface, primaryContainer, term0 ... term15. 'colours' is for every terminal; 'alacrittyColours' / 'windowsTerminalColours' / 'templatesColours' only for that one (they win). Set alacritty / windowsTerminal to false to leave that terminal alone.
_zenHelp: Zen browser: set zen to true and Aether colours it (chrome/aether-colours.css in your Zen profile, imported from userChrome.css; your mods stay). Restart Zen to see changes. zenColours names: accent, accentContainer, onAccentContainer, secondary, background, surface, surfaceHigh, surfaceHighest, text, border.
_templatesHelp: Any other terminal or app: a file of yours with {{foreground}}, {{background}}, {{cursor}}, {{red}}, {{brightBlue}}, {{term4}}, {{m3primary}} ... and where to write it. ~ = your home, %APPDATA% / %LOCALAPPDATA% work too.
